title: Why One Simple Rule Cut Baby Deaths In Half
hook: For years, the way we put babies to bed was killing them.
closing: Know a new parent? Tell them: back to sleep. It costs nothing and it works.
question: Did you know which way babies should sleep?

segments.say: SIDS deaths fell to 0.64 per thousand babies, less than half the 1991 rate. One simple change in how babies sleep did that.
Before the campaign, over 85% of SIDS cases were babies put down on their stomachs. Flipping them onto their backs did the trick.
About 3,400 babies still die in sleep-related deaths every year. The danger is smaller, not gone, so the back still matters.
